notes.title: May 2023 Update -- Bug Fixes on Beta Branch
notes.content:
We've uploaded a public beta branch! It has current fixes for users experiencing a bug or crash at the first animation part of the game's new engine. 

[b]Be warned that switching to the Beta build will delete your save data.
[/b]

Changes (Beta only)
[list]
[*] Visual effects have been lessened to load scenes smoothly.
[/list]

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Engine Upgrade + Other Fixes
notes.content:
We've got a major update for A Clockwork Ley-Line - Borderline of Dusk - With the 2nd and 3rd games released, we've decided to port the first game into the same engine. This update also includes the addition of English translated SD/CGs together with English credits! 

List of Updates:
- English SD/CG 
- English Credits / Staff Roll
- Removal of locale emulator loader
- Various text fixes

[b]PLEASE NOTE: [/b]This new update will delete all current saves, however, the old game build will be available in the branch named previous where your saves will remain playable. 

Thank you for your kind understanding.

Happy playing!

notes.title: 06/19/208 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Update locale emulator.
[*]Update loader to be 32bit.
[/list]

We're still working on a complete fix as well as looking at porting the other games in the series to Ren'Py or Unity as this engine is quite difficult to work with.

Unfortunately, due to how the engine is, saves get wiped however you can use the "previous" branch to avoid removing your saves.
